sections.label: Tagline
sections.content: The only mass-market brand to include three essential ceramides (1, 3, and 6-II) delivered via MVE technology for 24-hour hydration.

sections.label: Description
sections.content: CeraVe is a global skincare brand founded in 2005 that specializes in products formulated with three essential ceramides to restore the skin's natural barrier. Developed with dermatologists, the brand utilizes a patented delivery system called Multivesicular Emulsion (MVE) technology. It was acquired by L'Oréal in 2017 and is now a leading name in the mass-market dermatological skincare category.

sections.label: Core capabilities
sections.content:
CeraVe Moisturizing Cream
Hydrating Facial Cleanser
Foaming Facial Cleanser
Skin Renewing Retinol Serum.

sections.label: Target industry
sections.content: Individuals with sensitive skin, eczema, psoriasis, acne, and general consumers seeking clinical-grade skincare at affordable prices.
